status: declared 2026-11-10 before 3.17/4.0 real-reference reruns; old version verified from historical artifacts
supersedes: pendulum_gauge_v3.json; original manifests and analytic-reference artifacts retained.

data.source: GAUGE public pendulum trajectories (20 JSON, 30 fps, mm)
data.split: selection = odd trial IDs, held-out = even; each trial starts from its own measured release angle (~90 deg)
data.real_reference: Per-trial period and measured 3000-frame energy decay; both evaluated using identical metric code for real and simulated trajectories.

fixed.scene: GAUGE pendulum: 0.3175 kg ball (radius 30 mm, solid-sphere inertia) 0.278 m below an undamped world-y hinge at (0.37396, 0.49059, 0.445133) m; massless rod; no contact; geometry/inertia from the released mesh rather than an analytic sphere; reconstructed from the released MJCF prototype and physical metadata
fixed.release: from rest at the trial's measured angle; perturbation U(+-3 mrad); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.sampling: exact 30-Hz samples; dt = 1/(30 * integer steps-per-frame), avoiding accumulated rounded-dt drift
fixed.pass_gate: finite qpos AND qvel at every physics step; no measured capacity overflow; detectable final peak for both real and simulated 3000-frame trajectories
fixed.loss: mean over trial x repeat of |PD_sim / PD_real(trial) - 1| + |EL_sim - EL_real(trial)|. EL_real uses the same 3000-frame, peak-height equation as EL_sim; target is NOT zero. Raw-FFT PD is primary, refined PD and 300-frame 3D RMSE auxiliary.
fixed.mechanism_metrics: zero-padded PD (finer than the paper's 0.1-Hz bins), minimum EL (energy gain if < 0), 300-frame 3D RMSE vs the real trial
fixed.unmeasured_parameters: The released metadata has no hinge damping/rod inertia calibration; keep the published undamped/massless-link reconstruction. Do not claim that all real dissipative effects are identified.
fixed.LSD_note: 3D central-difference speed; no smoothing; eps_z=0.5 mm, v_th=5 mm/s, same code for real and simulation. Public-data LSD differs from paper table; do not assert exact LSD reproduction.

selection_rule: pass gate, then loss, then wall time
seed_rule: selection: seed0; held-out cell j: seed0 + 1000 + j

candidate_rule.rationale: contact-free hinge: SAP's only native option that changes these dynamics is solver precision; MuJoCo's are the integrators. No padding with duplicates.

held_out_conditions.axis: mass sensitivity only; compare with nominal real trajectory for context, not a measured mass-transfer fidelity test
mass sensitivity only; compare with nominal real trajectory for context, not a measured mass-transfer fidelity test

axis_coverage.mass: x0.5 / x1 / x2; only x1 has matching real measurements; shifted mass cells are sensitivity diagnostics, not real-data-validated transfer

not_run_conditions.reason: single GAUGE configuration; no real reference
